verdict.rationale: 2FAS's own docs say it generates HOTP and Steam Guard codes on iOS, Android and browser extensions, which covers two of the story's four non-standard token types. The evidence never mentions custom periods or digit lengths, and the HOTP and Steam Guard claim rests on a single first-party sentence. Missing for 10: documented custom TOTP periods, custom digit lengths, HOTP counter management detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, non-standard tokens work too — Steam Guard, HOTP counters, custom periods and digit lengths

citations.quote: Generate TOTP, HOTP and Steam Guard codes on iOS, Android and via browser extensions.
